plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked basilar membrane width, stiffness & travelling-wave envelope chart from Helmholtz (1863) and Békésy (1928–1947 / 1960 Experiments in Hearing) shows membrane width widening from ~0.1 mm at the base (20,000 Hz) to ~0.5 mm at the apex (20 Hz) while stiffness drops ~10,000-fold, causing each frequency's travelling wave to crest at a unique distance along the 35-mm ribbon.
